# Nowledge Mem / AI Now Agent

Select a model in **Magpie → Agents → Nowledge Mem / AI Now** for Nowledge's **Default, AI Now and Background** assignments. Magpie owns upstream accounts and routing; Nowledge connects to one dedicated native Magpie provider instance.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

This differs from [`@jianmu-plugins/gateway-nowledge-mem`](../nowledge-mem): that package recalls memories/Context Bundles for other harnesses and optionally imports conversations. This Agent controls the models **Nowledge itself uses**, performs no recall/capture, and needs no gateway memory plugin. Its directory is `nowledge-mem-agent` because `packages/nowledge-mem` already contains that separate package.

## Connect

```sh
magpie plugin add @jianmu-plugins/agent-nowledge-mem
magpie nowledge-mem <provider/model>
```

Or add this complete folder through Plugins → Add plugin. Install the whole package: `nowledge-mem.agent.js` runs in moejs and `main: index.mjs` runs the bridge in Magpie's Bun host. No runtime dependencies or installation scripts.

Keep both applications running. Local changes settle within two polls, normally 2–4 seconds. Start a new AI Now conversation; existing conversations or AI Identities with explicit overrides can keep their own models. Choose a tool-capable chat model.

The provider instance is `magpie:nowledge-agent`, displayed as **Magpie · Nowledge Agent**. Existing providers and credentials are preserved. The gateway URL and Agent key come from `connect`; full `provider/model` or `group/name` identifiers are sent unchanged, without a LiteLLM prefix.

Default, AI Now and Background share the selected model. Connection enables Remote mode; disconnection restores the original mode when still owned. Explicit embedding, OCR/vision and decision assignments are untouched; inherited vision follows Default.

The icon is Nowledge's official [favicon](https://mem.nowledge.co/favicon.png), used for identification. This is a third-party adapter.

## Backend and credentials

Default backend: `http://127.0.0.1:14242`. Save custom connection settings in `~/.config/magpie-nowledge-mem/adapter.json`:

```json
{
  "apiUrl": "https://your-mem.example.com",
  "apiKeyFile": "~/.config/magpie-nowledge-mem/nowledge.key",
  "pollMs": 2000
}
```

The key file contains the **Nowledge backend access key**, separate from Magpie's gateway key; restrict it to your user. `NMEM_API_URL` and `NMEM_API_KEY` also work. Explicit connection fields override environment values; Magpie plugin options override the file. GUI applications may not inherit shell environment variables. The standalone CLI does not read Magpie's saved plugin options, so use the shared adapter file for recovery.

Authenticated non-loopback backends require HTTPS. Redirects are rejected, and diagnostics omit server response bodies. Use the actual backend address shown by Nowledge. Across machines, Magpie's gateway address must be reachable from the Nowledge server; loopback always refers to that server's own machine. Hosted Nowledge Cloud workspaces manage their models and are outside scope.

Local configuration is checked every two seconds. For remote backends, unchanged successful checks back off to at most one every 30 seconds. The local selection file is still polled at the configured interval, so a new selection promptly restarts the quiet-period check.

## Disconnect, uninstall and recover

Disconnect the **Agent row** before disabling/removing the plugin or quitting Magpie. Keep the plugin and Nowledge running until restoration finishes:

```sh
magpie nowledge-mem default
```

If the package or host is removed first, asynchronous restoration is not guaranteed. When the selection file disappears while the host is alive, the loop treats it as a disconnect. If already removed, obtain a checkout/extracted copy of this package and run:

```sh
node cli.mjs status
node cli.mjs restore
node cli.mjs sync
```

Bun can run these commands too. `restore` restores still-owned settings and pauses the current selection; another model selection or explicit `sync` resumes management. Use the original backend URL and authentication.

**Keep `~/.config/magpie-nowledge-mem/state.json` until recovery completes.** It records original assignments and intended/applied writes, not existing provider secrets. Writes are atomic and `0600`, with a pid lock; the adapter directory and selection file permissions are tightened.

Manual purpose edits are retained and reported as conflicts. Changed providers and providers referenced by a manually selected purpose are retained. If the original default was empty, Nowledge can clear it only by removing this provider; new references can prevent that. An actionable error retains the journal until the conflict is resolved. Do not delete it to hide an incomplete restore.

The API exposes only `has_api_key`, so replacement of an existing instance's key is not detectable. Disconnect before editing that credential. There is no conditional-write API; a small external read/write race remains possible.

## Compatibility and the REST contract

Last actual create/remove contract check: **Nowledge Mem 0.10.115**, official desktop Rust service, **2026-11-07**. A temporary instance was removed, Remote mode was preserved, and original assignments were restored. The installed `nmem` CLI also reports `0.10.115`.

`magpie` is a native type shipped by that Nowledge version. This package does not register it. Its bundled Providers UI contains `providerType: magpie`; its bundled client declares:

| Endpoint | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /remote-llm/config` | Masked providers and explicit/effective purposes |
| `POST /remote-llm/config` | Save the independent instance with `provider_type: magpie` |
| `POST /remote-llm/purpose` | Assign `default`, `ai_now`, `background` |
| `POST /remote-llm/enabled` | Change Remote mode |
| `POST /remote-llm/provider/remove` | Remove an unchanged, unreferenced owned instance |

The evidence is the official installed assets `remote-routes-DB7HdQZR.js`, `client-yS6RTdNt.js`, `settings-view-D0HsZ7_I.js`, plus live API tests. These routes are **absent from the served OpenAPI document**. The public [embedding provider guide](https://mem.nowledge.co/docs/embedding-providers) also lists Magpie; the general [provider](https://mem.nowledge.co/docs/llm-providers) and [CLI](https://mem.nowledge.co/docs/cli) guides do not describe this full private routing contract.

A missing route, incompatible config schema, or failure to retain the native `magpie` type stops the adapter visibly before purpose assignments, preserving recovery data. It does not silently substitute another provider type. Later Nowledge versions remain unverified.

Actual host smoke: **Magpie 0.1.3212 on macOS**. Desktop-only install detection on the tested Mac uses `~/Library/Application Support/co.nowledge.mem.desktop`, the installed bundle's data directory; `nmem` on PATH is another signal. Other OS-specific desktop paths are not asserted. Linux/server installs can expose `nmem` on PATH; Windows desktop-only detection remains unverified.

## Development

```sh
bun test ./*.test.mjs
MAGPIE_BIN=/path/to/magpie node tests/magpie-smoke.mjs
node tests/nowledge-contract.mjs --read-only
```

Tests use `bun:test` next to source. The optional smoke test gives **child processes their own HOME/USERPROFILE, XDG config/cache/data and AppData directories**, disables account discovery, clears known agent path overrides, and refuses the caller's real home or escaped directories. It uses fake Nowledge/vendor endpoints, sends no paid inference, and leaves the caller's environment unchanged.

The contract script's default mode temporarily creates/removes a provider and refuses an enabled backend or configured providers. Read-only mode checks version, schema and an existing native Magpie instance with no writes. Do not use mutating mode on a live configured workspace.

The repository-root command `bun scripts/check.mjs nowledge-mem-agent` checks registry syntax/classification; its upstream checker skips Agent hook loading. Package tests and the optional host smoke cover behavior. See [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) for limits and mutation checks.

References: [Magpie plugins](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/zh/plugins), [gateway integration](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/integrate), [community publishing](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins#publishing).

# Nowledge Mem / AI Now — Magpie Agent 插件

在 **Magpie → Agent → Nowledge Mem / AI Now** 选择一个模型，同步到 Nowledge 的 **Default、AI Now、Background** 三项用途。上游账号、订阅、密钥、模型路由和故障切换由 Magpie 管理；Nowledge 只连接 Magpie 网关。

这是使用官方 Agent 扩展协议的第三方插件，不是 Nowledge 的 MCP 记忆插件。它不会把 Nowledge 变成 Magpie 的模型供应商。

与社区现有的 `@jianmu-plugins/gateway-nowledge-mem` 不同：本插件管理 **Nowledge 自己使用哪个模型**；现有 gateway 插件为其他 Agent 召回记忆、注入 Context Bundle，并按需导入对话。本插件不依赖该 gateway 插件，也不执行记忆召回或对话导入。

## 安装

要求：已运行的 Magpie、Nowledge Mem 桌面版或自托管服务；Nowledge 需要支持 `magpie` 类型和独立 provider 实例。开发与验证版本见 [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md)。Bun 由 Magpie 的插件宿主管理，没有 npm 依赖和安装脚本。独立诊断命令需要 Node.js 22+，或使用 `bun cli.mjs`。

1. 在 Magpie 的 **插件 → 添加插件** 中填写 `@jianmu-plugins/agent-nowledge-mem`，或选择下载解压后包含本文件和 `package.json` 的完整文件夹。
2. 确认 Magpie 的上游 provider 已经登录并有可用模型。
3. 打开 **Agent → Nowledge Mem / AI Now**，选择支持工具调用的模型或路由组。
4. 保持 Magpie 和 Nowledge 运行，通常等待 2–4 秒。Nowledge 的 Providers 页面会出现独立的 **Magpie · Nowledge Agent**，三项用途会使用你刚选的模型。开始一个新对话验证实际回答。

有 `magpie` 命令时可以安装社区包。使用版本号固定已测试版本：

```sh
magpie plugin add @jianmu-plugins/agent-nowledge-mem@0.1.0
```

也可在解压后的插件目录执行：

```sh
magpie plugin add "$PWD"
magpie nowledge-mem <供应商/模型>
```

macOS 未把 Magpie 加入 PATH 时，可用应用中的命令：

```sh
/Applications/magpie.app/Contents/MacOS/magpie plugin add "$PWD"
```

不要只导入 `nowledge-mem.agent.js`：这个插件同时需要 `main` 指定的 Bun 同步模块。不要导入 `.tgz` 文件作为本地目录；使用解压后的完整文件夹。

## 实际管理范围

| 项目 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| Default、AI Now、Background | 同步为 Magpie 当前选中的同一个模型 |
| Remote / Local 模式 | 首次接入启用 Remote；正常断开恢复接入前的值 |
| 其他 provider 及其密钥 | 不覆盖，使用独立实例 `magpie:nowledge-agent` |
| Embedding、Vision / OCR、Fast decisions | 不写它们的用途配置；**原本跟随 Default 的 Vision 也会随 Default 改变** |
| 已打开的对话、单次会话或 AI Identity 的显式模型覆盖 | 可能继续使用自己的模型；请开始新对话并检查其模型选择 |
| 模型能力 | 同步已知 context window、输出上限和图片能力；不臆造未知能力 |

网关 URL 和 Agent 专属 key 来自 Magpie 的 `connect` 入参，未固定网关端口，也不需要复制上游 key。使用完整 `provider/model` 或 `group/name`，不增加 `openai/` 前缀。请求采用 Chat Completions，Magpie 负责向上游协议转换。

## Nowledge 地址与认证

默认连接本机 `http://127.0.0.1:14242`。如果你的 Nowledge 使用其他端口、远程地址或访问 key，请创建：

`~/.config/magpie-nowledge-mem/adapter.json`

```json
{
  "apiUrl": "https://your-mem.example.com",
  "apiKeyFile": "~/.config/magpie-nowledge-mem/nowledge.key",
  "pollMs": 2000
}
```

`nowledge.key` 中只放 **Nowledge 服务的访问 key**，并设置文件权限为仅自己可读写。它与 Magpie 的网关 key 是两套凭据。不要把任何 key 提交到插件项目。

也支持宿主环境变量 `NMEM_API_URL`、`NMEM_API_KEY`；显式 `apiUrl` / `apiKeyFile` 优先。GUI 启动的应用未必继承终端的环境变量，优先使用上述文件。Magpie 的插件选项也支持相同字段，选项优先于文件。

独立 CLI 不会自动读取 Magpie 中保存的插件选项；使用诊断／恢复命令时，请把相同连接参数放入上述 `adapter.json` 或 CLI 的环境变量。

远程 Nowledge 必须使用 HTTPS 才能发送访问 key；HTTP 仅允许本机回环地址。接口重定向被拒绝。请使用 Nowledge 实际展示的连接地址，不推测远程 `/remote-api` 或其他部署路径。

Nowledge Mem **Cloud 托管工作区** 的模型由服务管理，不属于本插件适用范围。自托管 Nowledge 与 Magpie 分处两台机器时，还必须保证写入 Nowledge 的 Magpie 网关地址能从 Nowledge 服务所在机器访问；`127.0.0.1` 始终指服务自身。单独改 `apiUrl` 不能解决网关可达性。

## 状态与恢复

在插件目录执行：

```sh
node cli.mjs status
node cli.mjs sync
node cli.mjs restore
```

- `status`：显示后端地址、三项用途、是否有恢复日志和上次同步结果，不输出 key。
- `sync`：立即应用当前选择，并解除紧急恢复留下的暂停。
- `restore`：恢复仍由插件管理的设置；暂停当前选择，防止仍在运行的宿主马上重新接管。以后在 Magpie 改选模型，或执行 `sync`，可再次接管。

正常断开请在 **Magpie 的 Agent 行**关掉连接，或执行：

```sh
magpie nowledge-mem default
```

等待同步后，用 `node cli.mjs status` 确认 `recoveryPending` 为 `false`，再停用或卸载插件。**直接停用插件、退出 Magpie 或删除插件目录，会同时停止 Bun 同步模块，无法保证当时自动回滚。** 如果已经这么做，保留插件文件，启动 Nowledge 后执行 `node cli.mjs restore`。

恢复数据保存在 `~/.config/magpie-nowledge-mem/state.json`，状态在同目录 `status.json`。**恢复前不要删除 `state.json`。** 它记录原用途及插件自己的写入，不保存旧 provider 的 API key。写入采用权限 `0600` 的临时文件及原子替换；同步加进程锁，崩溃后保留日志供重试。同步宿主会将插件自己的标准目录收紧为 `0700`，并在读取选择文件前将其权限收紧为 `0600`。

如果你在 Nowledge 中手动修改了已接管的用途，插件会保留修改，并在日志／状态里报告 `conflicts`，以后不再覆盖该用途。如果手动改过插件 provider 的连接字段，或其他用途正在引用它，恢复时会保留该 provider。恢复完成后需要你自行核对再删除；不会直接覆盖或删除。

提供商列表只返回 `has_api_key`，无法判断用户是否手动替换了同一实例里的 key。因此请在 Magpie 管理期间通过 Magpie 切换连接，或先断开 Agent 后再编辑该 provider 的凭据。后端 API 没有条件写入机制；外部同时写设置时存在读取与写入之间的短暂竞争窗口。

## 排障

- Agent 未出现：确认安装的是完整文件夹，包中有 `package.json` 的 `magpie.agent` 和 `main`；检查 `nmem` 是否在 PATH；在 Magpie 里关开插件加载新版本。
- 选模型后未生效：打开 Nowledge，执行 `node cli.mjs status`，查看 Magpie 插件宿主日志；修改设置后需要让选择文件稳定一个轮询周期。
- `HTTP 401/403`：配置 Nowledge 访问 key 或核对服务权限；不能用上游模型 key 代替。
- `already exists`：同名独立实例已存在。先检查恢复日志并执行 `restore`；对于用户保留的实例，手动更名或删除后再连接，插件不会覆盖它。
- 没有默认 provider 但已有其他 provider：请先在 Nowledge 选一个默认 provider，保证断开时有可恢复目标。
- 后端离线：保持文件和恢复日志，恢复服务后自动重试。无法解析的 JSON 不会被当成断开。
- 命令行单次执行不会持久运行同步模块；持续同步需要 Magpie 应用或 `magpie serve` 保持运行。

## 开发与官方依据

```sh
bun test ./*.test.mjs
bun run check
MAGPIE_BIN=/Applications/magpie.app/Contents/MacOS/magpie node tests/magpie-smoke.mjs
npm pack
```

烟雾测试使用独立 Magpie 配置、临时插件副本及模拟 HTTP 服务，不调用真实模型。

- [Magpie 插件开发：Agent 插件](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/zh/plugins)：moejs Agent 模块、`connect`、Bun `main` 同步方案、键级恢复。
- [Magpie 应用接入指南](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/integrate)：动态模型目录、完整模型 id、网关协议及身份识别。
- [Nowledge LLM Providers](https://mem.nowledge.co/docs/llm-providers)：用途、OpenAI 兼容接口、上下文窗口。
- [Nowledge CLI](https://mem.nowledge.co/docs/cli)：provider 与用途配置。

Nowledge 的 provider 管理路由当前未包含在其公开 OpenAPI 中。本实现按 **0.10.115 官方应用附带的客户端代码**核对 REST 路由与请求体，并对实际运行服务检查 provider 的创建／删除行为。后续 Nowledge 版本改变这些接口时可能需要更新适配器。

许可证：MIT。

# Validation

Date: 2026-11-07 (Asia/Hong_Kong).

## Package checks

`bun test packages/nowledge-mem-agent`: **28 passed, 0 failed** on Bun 1.3.5/macOS. Tests use `bun:test` next to the source.

Full repository validation with the reviewer's **Bun 1.4.2**, under an isolated child home: **6614 passed, 9 skipped, 0 failed**, 479 files, 212.01 seconds. The older local Bun does not honor the repository's test exclusions and was not used as the full-suite result.

Coverage includes connection/switch/disconnection, original purposes and Remote mode, manual edits, partial failures, first-provider activation, legacy empty placeholders, journal/backend binding, locks, private atomic writes, malformed selections, emergency-restore pause, remote polling backoff, and incompatible REST responses.

The redirect case uses two HTTP servers on different hosts (`127.0.0.1` and `localhost`); it checks rejection, zero visits to the target and no received credential. The provider-reference test leaves its connection fingerprint unchanged so only the external reference protects it. The default-mode test changes Default during Background's restoration and checks Remote remains enabled. Poll-clock/file-read injection tests the quiet period without sleeping.

## Mutation checks

Each guard was removed alone, the package suite run in a fresh process, then the original source restored:

| Removed guard | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `redirect: 'error'` | 1 failing test |
| Quiet-period early return | 2 failing tests |
| `!referenced` before provider removal | 1 failing test |
| `defaultRestored` before disabling Remote | 1 failing test |

Restored source: 28 passed. `bun scripts/check.mjs nowledge-mem-agent` validates registry syntax/classification; it skips loading Agent hooks.

## Actual Magpie host smoke

`MAGPIE_BIN=/Applications/magpie.app/Contents/MacOS/magpie node packages/nowledge-mem-agent/tests/magpie-smoke.mjs` passed with Magpie **0.1.3212**.

Every child process receives its own HOME/USERPROFILE, XDG config/cache/data and AppData roots in a private temporary directory. Guards reject the real caller/account home and escaped directories; known agent-home overrides are removed. The caller's environment is not mutated. Account discovery is disabled. The descriptor is loaded unchanged; tilde paths resolve in the sandbox home.

Confirmed: Agent registration, sandboxed `connect`, dynamic gateway address/key, Bun-host synchronization of three purposes, model change, full disconnect recovery and `0600` selection file. Fake Nowledge and vendor endpoints received **zero model calls**. No live agent configuration is used.

## Nowledge contract evidence

Actual provider create/remove contract last run: **Nowledge Mem 0.10.115 on 2026-11-07**. The independent native `magpie:<id>` instance, context/output metadata, key masking, first-provider auto-activation and preserved Remote mode were checked. The temporary provider was removed and original assignments restored.

For this revision, `node tests/nowledge-contract.mjs --read-only` also passed against the running **0.10.115** service: version from OpenAPI metadata, required purpose fields and an existing `provider_type: magpie` confirmed with **no writes**. The opt-in mutating mode refuses enabled/configured backends.

The provider management routes are not present in that version's public OpenAPI. They were checked against its official installed client assets and live service; the exact routes and evidence are in README. An incompatible config or a backend that coerces the native type stops before purpose writes, with a visible error and retained journal.

## Limits

No actual paid inference, multi-turn tool use, long-context compaction, Windows desktop detection or subsequent Nowledge release is claimed as verified. macOS desktop data-directory detection was checked; other platforms retain PATH-based CLI detection. Uninstall before disconnecting can stop the bridge before restore: keep its journal and use the documented recovery CLI. External references can prevent clearing an originally empty default. These limits are explicit in README.

No user credentials, provider keys or Nowledge data are part of this package. No runtime dependencies or install scripts.
